SDK Update Log

26.3.0

New

  1. Supports setting whether to disable iOS gesture control by configuring setSwipeBack.
  2. Supports setting the background color of the IOS safe area.

25.12.0

New

  1. Mini Programs support adjusting the navigation bar title position.
  2. The webview component adds a loadingStyle attribute, providing a new page loading effect.
  3. Mini Programs add custom event communication APIs: removeCustomEvent and setCustomEvent.
  4. Mini Programs support configuring opening conditions and condition control.
  5. Mini Programs support configuring keywords.
  6. Supports multi-language support for Mini Program categories.
  7. Supports carrying parameters during H5 Mini Program navigation.

25.9.0

New

  1. The Macle Android SDK has been adapted to meet the new requirements based on Android 15 version, ensuring compliance for the host application's APP release.
  2. Supports the host application to open Mini Programs, scan QR codes to open Mini Programs, and hide the capsule during the download process of opening experience Mini Programs.
  3. Supports data caching based on online service resource caching strategies when loading online resources in webview, to accelerate the startup performance of Mini Programs.
  4. Supports reporting the result of SDK initialization failure to the Mini Programs management console.
  5. The Jump Mini Program API now supports hiding the capsule during the download jump process. Developers can use the newly added capsuleShow parameter to configure this (Minimum version: 25.9.0).
  6. The successful callback of the getNetworkType API has been updated to include the isConnectVPN field, which indicates whether the current device is connected to a VPN (Minimum version: 25.9.0).
  7. iOS has introduced new APIs for createTimer and cancelTimer (Minimum version: 25.9.0).

Optimization

  1. For security reasons, the Macle iOS SDK no longer depends on ZipArchive. If the integrated host application uses the decompression and compression capabilities of ZipArchive through the Macle iOS SDK, please rely on open-source software for compression and decompression.
  2. Preloaded Mini Programs support updating the Mini Program version.
  3. The Macle SDK continues to optimize its architecture to reduce the number of backend interface calls.
  4. The frequency of prompt upgrades for Mini Programs supports joint configuration with the Mini Program management console.

25.6.0

New

  1. The Macle iOS SDK adds the host-level configuration enableLoadingWhenStart, which supports controlling whether the loading of a locally deployed Mini Program is displayed when it restarts.
  2. The SDK provides an API to control the font in all interfaces within Mini Program, supporting a one-click skin change for the host application.
  3. Preloading of resources for shell Mini Program.
  4. Reporting of exceptions on the Mini Program cloud server.
  5. Support for configuring Mini Program upgrade strategies.
  6. global configurationA new global configuration item hideStatusBar for hiding the status bar.
  7. Support for H5 Mini Program in landscape mode, with configuration for screen rotation set to: "pageOrientation": landscape.

Optimization

  1. Distinguish the scenarios for reporting Mini Program downloads

25.3.0

New

  1. Add a license control mechanism for Mini Programs.
  2. Unified OpenAPI mechanism
  3. The screen rotation mode can be configured in the shell Mini Program.
  4. The SDK supports the interface for querying the latest Mini Program used by users.
  5. iossdk Xcode 16 compatibility
  6. Capsule HidesetCapsuleShow
  7. The Mini Program preloading
  8. Android SDK Google permission rectification
  9. Resumable download and multi-thread download
  10. Independent Ad Container

24.12.0

New

  1. Set the logo setTabBarBadge/removeTabBarBadge on the top right corner of the tabbar
  2. The Mini Program supports the keyboard height change monitoring onKeyboardHeightChange/offKeyboardHeightChange.
  3. The shell type can be configured in the shell Mini Program.
  4. Get System Settings getSystemSetting
  5. Allows Mini Programs to use the clipboard capability setClipboardData/getClipboardData
  6. The Mini Program supports the conversion between ArrayBuffer objects and Base64 strings base64ToArrayBuffer/arrayBufferToBase64
  7. Multi-language translation of dsl Mini Programs

24.9.0

New

  1. Customized buried points newly supports attribute reporting
  2. Added support for chooseVideo capability
  3. The SDK adds support for multi-language configuration of Mini Program names and descriptions.
  4. JS SDK newly supports synchronous data cache interface ma.getStorageSync, ma.setStorageSync
  5. SDK newly supports permission management and control interfaces ma.deauthorize and ma.cancelAuthorize
  6. Added support for users to open the last visited page
  7. The Mini Program supports APIs forbidding screen recording, screen capture, screen sharing, download (video), and screen projection.

Optimization

  1. Optimize the prompt message when downloading or opening the Mini Program fails
  2. Optimize the experience of JS SDK using custom APIs ma.callNative and ma.native to trigger callbacks, support triggering failure callbacks, and capture failure reasons.

24.6.0

New

  1. web-view component newly supports header customization
  2. Added the ability to report logs of the Mini Program startup process
  3. Added new exit Mini Program interface ma.exitMiniProgram
  4. Added support for Bluetooth pairing capability
  5. Added real machine debugging capability
  6. Added support for access source management and reporting capabilities
  7. Added support for custom buried points operational data reporting

Optimization

  1. Optimize the usage experience and style of the input component
  2. Optimize operation and maintenance log reporting capabilities
  3. Optimize the JS SDK integration experience, developers can quickly identify the integrated version based on the version number

24.3.0

New

  1. Added Login capability and supported[Get user public information] (GET_OPEN_USER_INFO)
  2. Added new Mini Program page parameters to support host applications sharing the current page of the Mini Program.
  3. Support classification and sorting of query Mini Program
  4. JS SDK new interfaces saveFileToPhone, saveImage, gotoBrowser
  5. Support the QR code of the Mini Program
  6. Support grayscale whitelist control

Optimization

  1. Support Mini Program page caching to optimize user experience and look and feel.
  2. IOS SDK supports removing the fixed white bar that appears at the bottom of the Mini Program.
  3. Optimize the Mini Program positioning capabilities of HarmonyOS models.

23.12.0

Optimization

  1. The IOS SDK uses the map component. When showLocation is false and the moveToLocation api is called without passing the latitude and longitude, the anchor point will no longer be moved to the current location and a failure callback will be triggered.
  2. Added verification mechanism for key files of Mini Program.

New

  1. Added support for data encryption storage
  2. Supports obtaining Mini Program startup parameters
  3. Support the back button in the upper left corner of the Mini Program to be hidden
  4. Added data prefetch API
  5. The log reporting API is added to allow developers to report problem logs.
  6. The Mini Program supports obtaining parameters from the URL
  7. Added the ability to jump to other Mini Programs within a Mini Program
  8. Android now supports H5 video full-screen playback.
  9. Added the ability to query the Mini Program list and Mini Program experience version based on the host application.

23.9.0

New

  1. New API: Added CameraContext.startRecord, CameraContext.stopRecord to support video recording function
  2. New framework: New basic operational data reporting
  3. Added new framework and added the ability to collect small programs (cooperated with the host App)
  4. Added new framework to support adding small programs to the desktop
  5. New API Added RecordManager recording manager, as well as recording functions such as starting recording and stopping recording, and event callback related APIs

Fix

  1. Repair the framework to adapt to the full-screen navigation mode of Xiaomi mobile phones

23.6.0

New

  1. New API: New FileSystemManager file manager, as well as writeFile, unlink, readFile and other file management related APIs
  2. Added new API loadFontFace to load user-defined font files
  3. New API Added DownloadTask, developers can check the progress of the download task and abort the download task

Optimization

  1. Update API to add internationalization capabilities of showModal and picker components
  2. Mini Program framework optimization

Fix

  1. Fix the compatibility of the white bar at the bottom of Hongmeng 3.0 Mini Program

23.3.0

New

  1. Added DSL Mini Program map component
  2. Added multi-language framework support
  3. Support Mini Program package signature verification

Optimization

  1. Optimize SDK engine external interface
